name: Marriage Gift Scheme (APBOCWWB)
_eligibility_text:
> **For construction workers themselves (Women only)** 1. Construction worker should be registered under the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Construction worker should be a woman. 1. Construction worker should be unmarried.
> **For daughters of construction workers** 1. A construction worker can receive the scheme benefits for up to two daughters. 1. The daughter(s) should have completed 18 years of age at the time of marriage.
